findings.description: Symbol normalization (trim whitespace + uppercase) enforced before alias lookup: code performs `symbol.trim().to_uppercase()` on every symbol regardless of alias presence, making resolution robust to incidental case/whitespace variation. Spec text does NOT state this normalization requirement — the spec says 'resolve a ledger Symbol...via config's alias map' but does not prescribe normalization of the lookup key.

Quote Date companion formula (locale-proof epoch encoding): code builds `=IFERROR(TEXT(INT(GOOGLEFINANCE("{ticker}","tradetime"))-DATE(1970,1,1),"0"),"")` as column M of Positions tab, using GOOGLEFINANCE's tradetime attribute rebased to days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01) and rendered via TEXT for locale-proof parsing. Spec sentence mentions only 'build the Price formula' and is silent on any Quote Date formula.

One-row-per-symbol invariant with loud error: code in render_positions() asserts `one row per symbol` via BTreeSet tracking, returning `Err(ViewError::DuplicateSymbolRow(symbol))` if violated. This is a defensive guard against future non-Map sources. Spec text is completely silent on this invariant or any requirement that symbol cardinality be enforced.
